reasoning: The pigeonhole principle states that if n items are placed into m containers and n > m, then at least one container must contain more than one item. Here we have 4 pigeons and 3 holes, with the constraint that each hole contains at most one pigeon. This is impossible because we would need at least 4 holes to place 4 pigeons with at most one per hole. Therefore the problem is UNSATISFIABLE.
